name: Casa de la Independencia Museum
scope: The street-corner Casa de la Independencia Museum in Asunción as seen in the two early published color references. Includes the whitewashed street wings, clay-tile roofs, raised entrance steps, open central garden court, and the gateway on 14 de Mayo. Omits interior exhibits, the separately mapped historic alley and the later recovery of the adjacent former stable lot.

originalReview.notes: Street-level view of the whitewashed brick gateway with segmental head and low red clay roof on 14 de Mayo. Wall and threshold are used. The historic notice and roadway objects are incidental.

references.filename: Casa de la Independencia museum, Asunción.jpg

originalReview.notes: Corner view establishes the low gabled roof in terracotta, gable-end windows, five openings on Presidente Franco, dark iron window grilles, whitewashed walls and a raised continuous plinth with independent terracotta steps. Surrounding buildings are incidental.

review.method: Original published Qualla files, exact Commons SHA-1 and explicit creator PD-self dedications
review.notes: The dated milestone represents the early Commons exterior record. The corner view has no creator-supplied exposure date. The two interior images were excluded.
